Desk cover explained after dinner
This article covers the basics for first-time travelers

Companion Animal Travel Desk: Travel Basics for Companion Animals

Aurelia Skyways keeps the process simple when you are bringing a companion animal. Start by checking the travel notes for your animal type, then speak with the passenger coordinator before you travel. That keeps the booking clean and avoids last-minute surprises at the airport.

For rabbits, the crate must meet the size rule before you arrive at the desk. <<FACT F070>> Bring the crate you plan to use, because staff will check fit, ventilation, and security together. If the crate does not pass, the team will tell you what to change before acceptance.

For reptiles, the desk handles the required fee as part of the travel setup. <<FACT F060>> Keep your travel documents ready and follow the handler's packing guidance, since reptiles need steady handling and a secure container. The desk ledger records any service change, so a small update can be handled without confusion.

At the airport, the passenger coordinator will review your animal, your booking, and any special service notes. If you are traveling with Murphy or another pet, keep the carrier closed until staff ask you to open it. That helps the line move smoothly and protects everyone nearby.

If your plans change, tell the Companion Animal Travel Desk as soon as you can. Clear notice helps staff adjust the file, confirm the right handling steps, and keep the trip on track from check-in to departure.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways.
